doc.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Reading and time in jail
summary: McLean became a reader in jail at The Tombs, Rikers Island and Hart Island.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: How active was your reading life at this time?

Reading? Eh, I would read, but I wasn’t really an avid reader until many years later, until I went to the joint. That’s when I started reading, because you didn’t have anything else to do when you were confined.
When did you go to the joint?
Where? What joints? What are we talking about?
Rikers – The Tombs, Rikers Island, Hart Island. Those are the only three places that I went.
